title: Add indexed access without editing a collection type

evidence.scope: Actual positional reads, node replacement, preserved sequence/length and null/negative/past-end rejection, including unchanged state after rejected writes.
Actual positional reads, node replacement, preserved sequence/length and null/negative/past-end rejection, including unchanged state after rejected writes.

goal: Use extension indexers when a type you cannot edit needs bracket reads or writes. Define bounds, null handling and traversal cost explicitly.

selectionNotes: Linked-list positional access is O(n), with no concurrent-mutation guarantee.
Only zero-based integer indexing is supplied; invalid slots and null receivers throw.
Use a named receiver and import the extension namespace; existing applicable instance members win.

constraints: The containing class is top-level, static and non-generic; the receiver must be named.
No private-member access, receiver storage or interface implementation is added.
Competing extension namespaces may make lookup ambiguous; control imports or retain helper methods.
Writes preserve count/order and reject invalid slots before mutation.
